about.intro: A lightweight Windows tray toolbox that combines select-to-translate, screenshot OCR, downloads and LAN file transfer in one process. Translation only sends your selected text to the engine you configure; file transfer stays on your LAN; no usage data is collected.

translate.baidu.ready:
Baidu Translate APPID / secret are not set.
Right-click the tray icon → Settings… → Translation → Engine
translate.microsoft.ready: Microsoft Translator needs no setup and is ready to use
translate.openai.ready:
The OpenAI-compatible engine needs setup: add a model and fill in BaseURL, model name and API Key.
Right-click the tray icon → Settings… → Translation → Engine → Add model.
For DeepSeek, use https://api.deepseek.com + deepseek-chat.
translate.youdao.ready:
Youdao Zhiyun app ID / app secret are not set.
Right-click the tray icon → Settings… → Translation → Engine → Vendor → Youdao.
Both values are in the App Management page at ai.youdao.com.
